Hello!
We are a team of student researchers at Columbia working with Professor Henry Yuen, and we wanted to see if you were interested in Coding Theory. We’ve formalized some basic definitions, properties, and associated lemmas for error correcting codes, including the Gibert-Varshamov bound. We also have plans to expand to include topics such as Reed-Solomon coding and others. You can take a look at our repository https://github.com/wurtylex/LeanECC. We’d like to be able to contribute these to CSLib.
